title: Validate the full physical-phone shopping flow and real dictation
source: Existing BACKLOG.md QA-001 row; selected with all non-REL-001 work on 2026-11-07.
finding: Coverage and physical acceptance task, not an observed application defect.
physical_reports_2026_11_08: User reported two findings during phone validation: earlier deletion has too little time after near-expiry Undo (UI-032; user selected a fresh 15-second window), and editor moved to the end of a long list remains under the keyboard when tapped to open it (UI-033). Both implemented and regression-verified under the user's unattended authorization, including desktop/native before-and-after evidence. Physical retests and overall shopping/dictation acceptance remain open.
automated_coverage: tests/INTERACTIONS.md maps model, actual-control Windows, real desktop VKB and isolated native Android coverage. Existing entry, Back, reset/cleanup and Undo recovery tests cover app mechanics; they do not establish real dictation or one-handed store use.
current_work: Extended actual-monitor/native Android validation and exercised real English Gboard speech recognition with synthetic audio, Return, keyboard continuity and restart persistence. General physical shopping is accepted by the 2026-11-11 user report; UI-035 is now phone-confirmed fixed; natural-speech details and the UX-007 sensitivity trial remain pending.
physical_shopping_2026_11_09: Monday 2026-11-09 physical shopping went well; user reports all major functionality worked as expected (reported 2026-11-11). Minor findings are UI-035 offscreen-editor/IME closure and UX-007 sensitivity evaluation at 110%. This establishes the general shopping-flow result, not unreported natural-speech transcripts, ruler measurements or additional physical devices.

verification.entry: out/remaining/android-entry-expanded/results.json: all 36 native records pass using actual Gboard/Return, control-driven edits, catalog lifecycle, Undo, checked-row controls and the 8 added cases. Exact saved identity/order/checks are retained; no microphone is activated.
verification.back: out/remaining/android-back-current/results.json and android-back-right-current/results.json: 13 checks per edge pass, including layer priority, live background/return and saved contents.
verification.gesture_helper_control: out/remaining/android-back-helper-control/results.json: 14 checks pass, including deliberate reorder/restore, cancelled-edge recovery and next swipe/correction. The helper's existing default 150 ms movement behavior is retained; the new duration argument is optional for held selector setup.
verification.windows: out/remaining/windows-controls.txt: flow 19, keyboard 6 and model 104 records pass. Full unchanged Windows suites were not repeated for this test/documentation work.
verification.continued_back: out/displays/android-back-full/results.json: all 75 records pass, including the full both-edge/IME/hold/cancel/complete/reorder/correction matrix and selector-only Back before drawer dismissal.
verification.continued_windows: out/displays/windows-controls.txt: model, actual editor-flow and desktop-keyboard CTest entries pass again after the connected-display test registration. The optional connected-display suite also passes on both actual monitors.
verification.synthetic_dictation: out/displays/android-dictation-verified/results.json: ten records pass through real English Gboard recognition from synthetic WAVs, exact expected transcripts, native Return and cold restart. Recognized Two cartons of milk and Bread, 6 rolls; recorded one terminal space at direct Return's commit boundary, and exact equality after an explicit Gboard Space commit. Host microphone access remains disabled; no natural-speech acceptance is claimed. Independent cleanup is recorded in cleanup.json. See reviews/QA-001.md.
verification.continued_undo: out/displays/android-undorecovery/results.json: all 24 native records pass, covering reachable per-action Undo with offscreen editor, exact order/IDs/flags, new-entry preservation, open IME, expiry and live-process background pause/resume.
verification.continued_long_list: out/displays/android-longlist-ime/results.json: all six native records pass with 80 items, actual IME/insets, both scroll directions, rendered background continuity, keyboard hiding and unchanged saved contents.
verification.dictation_driver_regressions: tests/android/test_dictation_control.py: three offline controls fail the earlier driver snapshot and pass after acquisition/close/disconnect cleanup corrections. Reports: out/displays/dictation-control-before.txt and dictation-control-after.txt.

remaining: General physical shopping passed on 2026-11-09; UI-035 is phone-confirmed fixed on 2026-11-11. Await the UX-007 110% sensitivity trial and retain the separate dictation acceptance below.
Real speech/dictation with quantities/punctuation in the normal language; record recognized versus saved text and keyboard continuity.
back_phone_confirmation: UI-006 closed on 2026-11-08: user confirmed the explicit phone Back checklist. This does not establish the separate real shopping/dictation acceptance criteria.
limitations: No physical phone was connected at the 2026-11-07 device inventory. Scripts target only emulator-5580. The separate opt-in synthetic speech test activates the emulator's Gboard virtual input with host microphone access disabled; ordinary entry tests never activate speech. Those automated runs do not establish natural-speech or physical acceptance. The later Monday shopping report supplies general one-handed acceptance; natural-speech details remain unreported.
closure_criteria: Record the physical shopping and real dictation results in reviews/QA-001.md, in addition to the repeatable app-side checks. Keep unsupported recognizer/device claims explicit.
